summary.text: Carl Tepper is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 84 who has served since January 10, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Margaret Durham is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Carl Tepper served in the U.S. Air Force and earned a degree from Texas Tech University, and his career experience includes working as a real estate professional, according to Ballotpedia.
He has served as president of the Sunset Saddle Club, chairman of the Lubbock County Republican Party and president of the Texas Republican County Chairmen's Association.
He assumed office in the Texas House on January 10, 2023, succeeding John Frullo, and for 2023-2024 was assigned to the Urban Affairs and Appropriations committees.
